subset: west=46.5, south=40.5, east=87.5, north=55.5; study bbox, not a national aggregate

result.method: Exploratory FRP OLS through origin; 0.25° grid / UTC day; chronological 70/30 date split
limitations: Only cells/days with detections by both sensors are paired; absence is not zero.
FRP sums mix overpasses; grid is not equal area. No cloud, view-angle, land-cover or temporal correction.
VIIRS is a comparison reference, not ground truth. Holdout metrics are internal checks.
No historical extrapolation, burned area or operational risk prediction.
